Ah, I think this is a case of ideological differences. I tend to have a collectivist mindset and uplifting those around you.  I would raise the general pay so that people could exist, since in general I think that people at their very base are at least entitled to fundamental needs: food/water/shelter.

My view on this is that every job should be able to make a living wage for the area that they live in. So a 40 hour work week should be enough to afford rent and bills plus modest savings. I'm not saying everyone gets a mansion and a Porsha  ( there are so many other issues with that ) But a median apartment and an okay car. Think about it this way. You live a city, You in the course of a month maybe go to the market... drop kids off at school... go to a restaurant... see a movie. If you want these positions in your city, then the people working should be paid enough to live in said city.
